scripts.lint:palette: ! grep -rnE '\b(text|bg|border|from|to|via|ring|divide|fill|stroke|placeholder|accent|decoration|outline)-(indigo|emerald|slate|zinc|neutral|lime|sky|rose|fuchsia|stone)-[0-9]{2,3}\b' src2 || (echo 'ERROR: colour family not in the frappe-ui/Espresso palette. Available: gray blue green red amber orange yellow teal cyan purple pink violet' && exit 1)
scripts.lint:tokens: ! grep -rnE '\b(bg-(ink|outline)-|text-(surface|outline)-|(border|ring|divide)-(ink|surface)-)' src2 || (echo 'ERROR: semantic families are role-scoped by the frappe-ui preset (plugin.js): text-* takes ink only, bg-* takes surface only, border/ring/divide-* take outline only. Crossing them emits ZERO css.' && exit 1)
scripts.lint:svg: ! grep -rnE '(stroke|fill)="#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}"' src2/dashboard src2/intelligence src2/components/financial src2/components/strategic-finance || (echo 'ERROR: raw hex in an SVG presentation attribute. These bypass lint:palette (which greps Tailwind CLASS names, not attributes) and stay light-mode fixed under data-theme=dark. Use var(--surface-*) / var(--outline-*) / var(--app-*-fill), matching whatever legend swatch the shape pairs with.' && exit 1)
scripts.lint:currency: ! grep -rnE "currency: *'[A-Z]{3}'|'(KES|INR|USD|EUR|GBP|AED|ZAR) *[0-9]|(KES|INR|USD|EUR|GBP|AED|ZAR) [$][{]" src2/dashboard src2/intelligence src2/components/financial src2/components/strategic-finance src2/components/charts --include='*.vue' --include='*.ts' | grep -v '[.]spec[.]ts' | grep -v withDefaults || (echo 'ERROR: currency written as a literal. Money must be labelled by the ledger, not the source: read base_currency from the payload and pass it to formatMoney. A constant silently mislabels every figure on any site reporting in something else -- HR shipped KES and Tax shipped INR on the same company, which reports in neither. A withDefaults prop fallback is exempt (callers pass the real code, and Intl throws on undefined); formatting with a constant is not. ASCII-only on purpose: a currency-symbol character class makes BSD grep exit on an illegal byte sequence, which the leading ! then inverts into a silent pass.' && exit 1)
scripts.lint: yarn lint:palette && yarn lint:tokens && yarn lint:svg && yarn lint:currency
